title: Note action placement
subtitle: Current elements and proposed L2/L3 ownership, compared surface by surface

components.title: Libraries create. Notes act on themselves.
components.body: L2 owns navigation and discovery. L3 owns the current view or current page. Sticky headers hold only high-value primary actions and shared chrome; mobile carries the same contextual model.

components.title: How to read this version
components.body: Every surface now has a Current block describing what exists today and an Updated block proposing the target. The Updated column is a design contract, not a claim that the behavior is implemented.

components.title: Shared chrome on every screen
components.body: Chromecast is available on every library, collection, and detail screen. Desktop keeps it in the sticky header; mobile keeps it in the top navbar. Mobile bubbles are ordered bottom-up: Search, contextual New or primary action when available, then the … menu containing L3 controls and helpful actions.

items.title: Navigation mixed with query controls
items.body: Route landing, Custom and saved WQL shortcuts, view-switching links, optional New actions, source links, and filter accordions share the panel.

items.title: Navigation and discovery only
items.body: Navigation for the view; predefined WQL queries saved under meaningful labels; recent notes or items in that view; scoped creation where useful. Filters and grouping move out. Chromecast remains available on every screen as shared chrome, not L2 content.

items.title: Stream view controls
items.body: Layout, visible fields, grouping, and route query settings appear in the right rail on wide screens and collapse into page options on narrower screens.

items.title: Current-result WQL controls
items.body: Filters, grouping, layout, visible fields, time windows, and other controls that change the current query or result presentation. No navigation and no entry creation.

items.title: Generic relationship sections
items.body: NoteContextNav can publish Up, Source, Efforts, Journal copies, and Related workouts. Otherwise the route keeps its library-oriented L2 panel.

items.title: Orient, then discover related work
items.body: First link Up to the owning list. Add navigation appropriate to the note type, including a calendar widget for journal notes. Follow with important and recent workouts, linked notebooks, efforts, and equipment. Ordering is specified per page below.

items.title: Outline with inconsistent action placement
items.body: On-this-page links and occasional Run or Edit actions are available. Download lives in page options, while Placements, Clone, Move, Reset, and similar actions usually remain in the sticky header.

items.title: Current-page links and helpful actions
items.body: On-this-page links first, followed by actions that make sense for this specific note: Add timer, Clone, Placements, Move, Reset, Open in playground, planning, or download. Each page declares its own set; unrelated global creation is excluded.

components.title: Implementation sequence
items: Separate library creation from shared detail PageActions and remove the unconditional mobile journal-plus.
Split L2 navigation and recent-item discovery from L3 filter, grouping, and WQL controls.
Give every note route an explicit Up link and type-appropriate L2 navigation.
Declare each note's L3 outline and helpful actions locally instead of inheriting a universal action set.
Mirror the same ownership model into mobile overflow rather than creating a separate mobile action philosophy.

components.title: Status
components.body: Current blocks are grounded in the existing route and action components. Updated blocks are proposed behavior for review; they are not implemented by this whiteboard.
